mechanism_narrative: Sustained upward trend in RETAIL_REC (from -42.9% to -38.6% over four weeks) indicates consistent recovery momentum. This trend will continue linearly over the next four weeks, producing higher mean RETAIL_REC than the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.3 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean of the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility recovery (from -28.0% to -24.4%) signals confidence in commuting safety. Workers returning to offices increase weekday retail visits and social activity, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -25% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 3.6 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase when WORKPLACES exceeds -25% threshold in the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility shows volatile but improving trend (from -26.0% to -15.4%). Rising outdoor recreation signals population confidence and mobility freedom. This confidence spills over into retail-and-recreation visits, producing higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -15% for one week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 10.6 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise when PARKS exceeds -15% threshold, or PARKS reverses below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility (from -42.1% to -37.7%) and RETAIL_REC (from -42.9% to -38.6%) move in lockstep, both improving at similar rates. Joint recovery in transit and retail indicates coordinated reopening. Continued transit recovery will drive retail recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:Both series improved 4-5 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC diverge (one rises while the other falls) for two consecutive weeks, or both decline.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM remains near baseline (from -4.3% to -0.4%), indicating essential services are unrestricted. Persistent access to essential services signals low restriction severity. Under low-restriction regimes, RETAIL_REC recovers faster than under high-restriction regimes, producing higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above -2% for all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining near baseline, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5%.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility (from 24.3% to 22.6%) shows slight decline, indicating population is leaving homes more frequently. Reduced home-confinement behavior combined with improving WORKPLACES (from -28.0% to -24.4%) creates conditions for retail visits. RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines below 23% and WORKPLACES improves above -25% simultaneously
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above 25% or WORKPLACES falls below -26%, or RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-June timing in Singapore (post-Phase 2 reopening period) combined with improving PARKS (from -26.0% to -15.4%) and TRANSIT (from -42.1% to -37.7%) suggests seasonal summer activity surge. Seasonal demand for retail-and-recreation peaks in June-July, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed prior 28-day mean, or PARKS and TRANSIT both decline in the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility (from -42.1% to -37.7%) recovery is necessary but insufficient for RETAIL_REC growth. Only when TRANSIT improves above -35% AND WORKPLACES simultaneously exceeds -23% does retail footfall surge. This dual-threshold condition will be met within two weeks, driving RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT exceeds -35% AND WORKPLACES exceeds -23% in the same week
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT fails to exceed -35% or WORKPLACES fails to exceed -23% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase when both thresholds are crossed.
